title: More choices for text generation
summary:
Three text models joined the lineup, a community dashboard made the projects list, and the JSON-mode example got tidier.

Added Scaleway-backed `qwen-coder`, `mistral`, and `llama` text models, with JSON-mode support. Text responses now retain full completion objects, alongside changes to streaming, caching, and error handling. The text model list also gained `llama` and dropped `llamalight`.

Added @sugamdeol’s Polli API Dashboard to the homepage’s SDK Libraries list and the README project table. It shows real-time statistics from the text feed.

Simplified the JavaScript text-generation example while keeping `jsonMode` documented in the request-body example as an optional way to request valid JSON.

highlights.title: Three more text models
highlights.text: Generate text with `qwen-coder`, `mistral`, or `llama`, with JSON-mode support. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
